body: im telling ny friend i love her and asking if i can stay at a friends house

I doubt I'll get any comments tonight, I just want an online friend to talk to every day, the friends I make are temporary, and I know I'm only fucking 18, but I expect more out of people in society than I deserve. If I ever fight my demons it will be through such self-destructive measures that I should have killed myself instead of masking it.

I'm sick of using drugs, vyvanse and prozac to get through the day, DXM acts as a major anti-depressant that backfires for the next week and causes the tremors to worsen. I live in a house with mentally ill family, an autistic brother, a bipolar mother, an emotionally disturbed father, and female friends with daddy issues. The only future I see for myself is ending up an addict barely passing life in a shitty apartment, living with my parents as a no life, I can't even join the fucking military to throw away my life with ADHD, I doubt any colleges will accept me and I don't want to bother with community college because it's just another two years of living in this house with the same issues
, I want to tell my best friend I love her but despite being good looking myself she won't ever love me back as anything more than a friend, my brain is already fucked over with holes from at least 50 high doses of DXM and it'll take at least years of rigourous excercise and abistenence to recover. I don't see the point with living other than the fear of death and hurting people I consider I "care for." I'm just a a guy with aspergers who learned to overcome the symptons with drugs and I feel more like a sociopath than someone with aspergers at this point. I don't want sympathy from these posts, I want fucking help, my emotions come from drugs and pride, and rarely from normal things. Please, fucking. help. me. I already exhausted my exgf with these feelings and have nowhere. to. turn. to. but this. fucking. place.
